Status.note:
This confirms the unit is still operating.

Status:
- Open the EIA-860M table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx and go to the Operating sheet. Plant ID 56031, Fox Energy Center, has three rows, CTG1, CTG2 and STG, all with Unit Code CC1 and status '(OP) Operating'.
- The Planned Retirement Year column is blank for all three rows. The Planned, Retired and Canceled or Postponed sheets have no rows for this plant.
- The nameplate figures are 198.9, 198.9 and 221.0 MW, which add to 618.8 MW and match the 619 MW GEM shows.
- The We Energies engineering plan filed in October 2026 for Fox North at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=614115 says in section 2.1 on the Proposed Project Location page that 'Fox Energy Center currently consists of a 593 MW two-on-one (2x1) combined cycle facility'. That is a second document that shows the plant running. It gives 593 MW, which differs from the nameplate sum, so I did not use it for capacity.
- No retirement, mothballing or owner change was found in either document.

Backup Power.note:
No document says in so many words that this plant is not a backup plant. The value no is implied.

Backup Power:
- Open the We Energies engineering plan for Fox North at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=614115 and go to section 2.1, Proposed Project Location. It describes Fox Energy Center as a 593 MW two-on-one combined cycle facility on 234 acres of Wisconsin Public Service Corporation property, with two F-class combustion turbines 'designed to consume natural gas'.
- It describes a utility power plant that sells to the grid. It does not describe a backup or standby role, and the plant serves no data center.
- The EIA-860M table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx lists the plant's sector as Electric Utility.
- Section 2.3.15 of the same plan mentions backup generators, but those belong to the proposed Fox North project, not to the existing plant.

units.notes: The unit is still operating with no retirement, mothballing or owner change announced. Backup Power no is only implied by the documents.
